# chen_confirm card (generated by scripts/phase3_chen_confirm.py; analysis exactly as in PREREG.md)

N = 56 participants (Exp 1: 29, Exp 2: 27); 3 repeats x 10 participant-disjoint folds (seeds 3031-3033); 2000 participant-bootstrap resamples; all CIs are 95% percentile intervals.

## 1. Primary test

Outcome: person-level detection at calibrated FPR <= 7% (mean over participants and repeats), I2b minus the paper's rate rule.

- Delta = **+0.1667** (95% CI +0.0298 to +0.2917); one-sided bootstrap p = **0.0105** (alpha .05); lower bound of the 90% CI = +0.0536.
- **Hypothesis confirmed: True.**
- Sensitivity, sign-flip randomisation (one-sided): p = 0.0108. Per repeat delta: +0.1429, +0.1964, +0.1607. Participants gaining / losing / tied: [15, 4, 37].
- Realised FPR on held-out control-1 vs control-2: I2b 0.065, rate rule 0.092; difference -0.027 (-0.086, +0.036).

| Experiment | n | I2b detection | Rate-rule detection | Delta (95% CI) | FPR I2b | FPR rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| exp1 | 29 | 0.552 | 0.448 | +0.103 (-0.046, +0.264) | 0.069 | 0.092 |
| exp2 | 27 | 0.642 | 0.407 | +0.235 (+0.024, +0.444) | 0.062 | 0.093 |

(Per-experiment rows are descriptive, not tested.)

### Confound (b): missing-sample fraction, familiar vs control (paired by participant, 0-2500 ms)

Mean familiar 0.0022, control 0.0031, difference -0.0010 (95% CI -0.0018, -0.0003); Wilcoxon two-sided p = 0.0330; familiar higher in 15, control higher in 27 participants. Exp 1: -0.0012 (p = 0.122); Exp 2: -0.0007 (p = 0.170).

Trial order (familiar minus control): trial number +0.35 (p = 0.769); block +0.011 (p = 0.813).

Per 100-ms bin (descriptive, uncorrected): 0-100: +0.0003 (p=0.594); 100-200: -0.0006 (p=0.575); 200-300: +0.0011 (p=0.359); 300-400: +0.0002 (p=0.695); 400-500: -0.0010 (p=0.100); 500-600: -0.0004 (p=0.480); 600-700: -0.0016 (p=0.011); 700-800: -0.0012 (p=0.050); 800-900: -0.0013 (p=0.028); 900-1000: -0.0015 (p=0.041); 1000-1100: -0.0006 (p=0.501); 1100-1200: -0.0014 (p=0.079); 1200-1300: -0.0034 (p=0.013); 1300-1400: -0.0029 (p=0.003); 1400-1500: -0.0024 (p=0.007); 1500-1600: -0.0032 (p=0.001); 1600-1700: -0.0014 (p=0.241); 1700-1800: -0.0001 (p=0.709); 1800-1900: +0.0001 (p=0.977); 1900-2000: +0.0006 (p=0.719); 2000-2100: -0.0027 (p=0.058); 2100-2200: -0.0014 (p=0.223); 2200-2300: -0.0001 (p=0.732); 2300-2400: -0.0002 (p=0.798); 2400-2500: +0.0014 (p=0.230)

### Confound (c): does the gain survive removing the missing channel?
I2b gain +0.1667; I2b-noMiss gain +0.1607 (Holm p = 0.0400); ratio noMiss/I2b = 0.9642857142857144. Pre-specified rule (noMiss gain significant after Holm at .05): **True**.
